environment.docker_vm: Isolated Colima profile, VZ arm64 Linux, 6 vCPU, 8 GiB RAM
environment.api: One Uvicorn worker using the same image for all three prefetch modes
environment.client: One host Python 3.13.14 process per run; SDK uses the checked-out source
environment.fixture_database: Both profiles in one PostgreSQL database and in separate uploads.

fixture.fixture: Identical Base64(SHAKE-256(width, width ordinal)) payloads in two orders

untimed_hard_payload_verification.description: Untimed verification of NDJSON payload bytes in actual returned PostgreSQL batches. The byte cap excludes PostgreSQL wire framing, SQL work memory and process RSS.

method.execution: Fresh PostgreSQL and API containers per run, persistent fixture volume; no manual host/VM page-cache drop. SDK validates ordering, row count, wire bytes and SHA-256 for each export.
method.cpu: API and PostgreSQL cgroup cpu.stat deltas around SDK invocation; client process CPU during concurrent export. Average cores divide CPU seconds by wall time reported by SDK.
method.memory: Kernel cgroup lifetime memory.peak for both fresh containers (includes startup, page cache and other cgroup memory); PID 1 VmHWM for API and ru_maxrss for SDK. PostgreSQL query-process RssAnon is a sampled sum of simultaneous observations, plus largest individually observed backend VmHWM. Non-idle includes idle-in-transaction backends with an open export.
method.hard: The first fetch requests one row. A recursive indexed keyset query then builds batches of up to 32 rows and bounds returned UTF-8 NDJSON payload to 2 MiB per fetch, including newlines. Oversized rows are fetched in slices and reassembled by the API. The cap excludes protocol framing, PostgreSQL work memory and process RSS.
method.alternating: A 220-byte JSONB payload before every wide payload.
method.bursts: 65 narrow then 64 wide; 62 groups of 64 narrow then 64 wide; 63 narrow then 64 wide.
method.wide_rows: First of every four wide payloads is 768 KiB; the other three are 256 KiB. Both profiles use the same counts and total bytes.
method.comparison: Warmups excluded; summary contains per-run min, median and max for each profile, concurrency and prefetch mode.
